OBSERVED.definition: Direct factual measurements from the executed production route and harness runtime.
OBSERVED.allowed_claims: Factual historical record of what actually happened.

COUNTERFACTUAL.definition: The deterministic recommendation generated by the shadow evaluator that was explicitly NOT executed.
COUNTERFACTUAL.authority: Advisory calculation only; zero execution authority
COUNTERFACTUAL.allowed_claims: Advisory preference under frozen evaluation rules.

DERIVED.definition: Deterministic mathematical computations derived entirely from OBSERVED inputs.
DERIVED.allowed_claims: Mathematical properties of the observed execution stream.

ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL.definition: Bounded mathematical projections of what might have occurred if the shadow recommendation had been intervened and executed.
ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL.allowed_claims: Hypothetical opportunity count or price difference estimate ONLY.

UNKNOWN.definition: Any property where required empirical data or deterministic link is missing.

inviolable_principles: Shadow route was not executed; it cannot claim empirical token or cost savings.
Never combine observed and counterfactual metrics into one unlabeled metric.
If empirical data is insufficient, output UNKNOWN.
